titles.romaji: Eiyuu-ou, Bu wo Kiwameru Tame Tenseisu Mini Anime
titles.native: 英雄王、武を極めるため転生す ミニアニメ

description:
Ahead of the TV anime broadcast of Eiyuu-ou, Bu wo Kiwameru Tame Tenseisu: Soshite, Sekai Saikyou no Minarai Kishi♀, a series of short mini animations posted on the HJ Bunko YouTube channel and the official Eiyuu-ou anime Twitter account.

Note: Mini anime series made for the TV Anime.
